archetypes.name: scope-threading
archetypes.rationale: Verify that every shell variable the plan references at proposed call sites—SESSION_ROOT in scout-dynamic-archetypes.sh, CODEX_PRESENT in plan-review-loop.sh, CODEX_AVAILABLE/CURSOR_AVAILABLE in dispatch-panel.sh—is actually set and in-scope at those exact locations in the current scripts.
archetypes.prompt_body: For each script the plan proposes to modify, read the current file and check whether the shell variables it assumes are readable at the new call sites—SESSION_ROOT, CODEX_PRESENT, CODEX_AVAILABLE, CURSOR_AVAILABLE—are actually exported or set at those locations, not just conditionally set elsewhere or defined under a different name. Pay particular attention to _run_plan_review_round in plan-review-loop.sh, where the plan adds --codex-present "$CODEX_PRESENT" without confirming that variable is in scope there. Flag any variable that is absent, undefined, or only conditionally set at the proposed call site. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: validation-gate-consistency
archetypes.rationale: After removing the 256 KB size check, the remaining validate_context_input_file guards (canonical-path, no-symlink, no-.., allowed-root) will run against staged paths under SESSION_ROOT; verify those paths would actually pass the allowed-root check as currently implemented.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read validate_context_input_file in scripts/scout-dynamic-archetypes.sh and list every remaining guard that stays after the plan's 256 KB removal. Determine whether the allowed-root check enumerates a fixed set of permitted path prefixes and whether $SESSION_ROOT/staged-context/ would fall inside that set, or whether a new allowed-root entry must be added. Also check whether the stage_context_file helper's cp destination produces canonical, symlink-free paths that would re-pass the no-symlink and no-.. guards if the staged file is itself re-validated on a subsequent call. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: override-variable-isolation
archetypes.rationale: The plan splits test overrides into two variables (SCOUT_DYNAMIC_ARCHETYPES_LAUNCH_REVIEW_SH for the Codex tier, SCOUT_DYNAMIC_ARCHETYPES_LAUNCH_SH for the Claude tier); existing tests and callers that already set the latter must not silently suppress Codex-tier invocations or break the waterfall under the new split.
archetypes.prompt_body: Search the repo for every existing caller, harness, or env-set that references SCOUT_DYNAMIC_ARCHETYPES_LAUNCH_SH and verify whether the plan's two-variable split preserves their existing stub semantics—specifically that setting SCOUT_DYNAMIC_ARCHETYPES_LAUNCH_SH no longer intercepts the new Codex-tier call that now routes through SCOUT_DYNAMIC_ARCHETYPES_LAUNCH_REVIEW_SH. Also confirm the plan's test-scout-dynamic-archetypes.sh update uses the correct override variable per stub so Codex-tier and Claude-tier assertions cannot cross-contaminate each other's exit-code signals. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
